title: two DSH profiles and no -Profile: refuse to guess which patch chain is loaded
titleZh: 两个 DSH profile 且没给 -Profile:拒绝猜哪条 patch 链在生效
why: defensive-spec section 7 case 9: silently reading the first profile is how a wrong answer looks exactly like a right one. A temporary DSH_HOME carrying two profiles is built for this case, so the collector's own profile discovery is exercised for real (not fixture-injected).
inject: a temp DSH_HOME with profiles Alpha and Beta, no -Profile argument
